record.explanation: The printed PDF page 4 shows cot 54° / tan 36°, which equals 1 because cot 54° = tan 36°. The supplied stem instead shows a sum, whose value is 2 tan 36° ≈ 1.4531 and matches none of the supplied options; the printed fourth option also reads 3/4 rather than the supplied 2. Held pending correction or clarification of the source transcription.
